title.zh: 卷392 列傳一百七十九 赛尚阿 讷尔经额
title.en: Volume 392 Biographies 179: Sai Shang A, Ne Er Jing E
title.raw: 卷392 列傳一百七十九 赛尚阿 讷尔经额

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿，字鶴汀，阿魯特氏，蒙古正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Sai Shang'a, courtesy name Heting, of the Arute clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Shang'a, whose courtesy name was Heting, belonged to the Arute clan and came from the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十一年繙譯舉人，授理籓院筆帖式，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Jiaqing he passed the translation-track provincial examination, was appointed a copyist at the Court of Colonial Affairs, and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 21 (1816) he qualified as a translation-track provincial graduate, received appointment as a copyist at the Court of Colonial Affairs, and served on the Grand Council staff.

sentences.zh: 宣宗命樞臣甄別所屬，賽尚阿列一等，予優敘。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor ordered the Grand Council ministers to evaluate their subordinates; Sai Shang'a was ranked first class and given preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: When the Daoguang Emperor ordered Grand Council ministers to grade their subordinates, Sai Shang'a was placed in the top tier and granted preferential advancement.

sentences.zh: 洊遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in steady succession to the rank of director.

sentences.zh: 道光十一年，擢內閣侍讀學士，偕將軍富俊按吉林將軍福克精阿剋扣兵餉，得實，劾罷之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Daoguang he was promoted to Reader in the Grand Secretariat, and together with General Fu Jun investigated the Jilin general Fukejing'a for embezzling military pay; the charge was substantiated and Fukejing'a was impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 11 (1831) he was promoted to Reader in the Grand Secretariat and, together with General Fu Jun, investigated Jilin General Fukejing'a for skimming military pay; the case proved true, and Fukejing'a was impeached and removed.

sentences.zh: 予頭等侍衛，充哈密辦事大臣，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was granted the rank of first-class imperial bodyguard, appointed Commissioner at Hami, and promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the rank of first-class imperial bodyguard, appointed commissioner at Hami, and then promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂回旗，留京，遷理籓院侍郎，兼副都統，調工部。

translations.literal: Upon completing mourning for his father he returned to his banner but remained in the capital, was transferred to vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, concurrently served as vice commander of the banner, and was moved to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: After observing mourning for his father he returned to his banner but stayed in the capital, became vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and concurrent vice banner commander, and was then transferred to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 迭赴盛京、廣東、察哈爾按事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly sent to Mukden, Guangdong, and Chahar to conduct investigations.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent in turn to Mukden, Guangdong, and Chahar on investigative assignments.

sentences.zh: 十五年，命在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was ordered to study and serve under the Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1835) he was assigned to train in attendance on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 調戶部，擢理籓院尚書，兼都統，調工部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs with concurrent appointment as banner commander, and then transferred to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to the Ministry of Revenue, was promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs with concurrent banner command, and was later transferred again to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，海疆戒嚴，詔赴天津、山海關勘築砲台，复偕御前大臣僧格林沁查閱海口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the maritime frontier was placed on alert; he was ordered to Tianjin and Shanhaiguan to survey and build batteries, and again accompanied the imperial commissioner Sengge Rinchen in inspecting the estuaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1841), with the coast on war footing, he was ordered to Tianjin and Shanhaiguan to survey and build batteries, and again accompanied Imperial Commissioner Sengge Rinchen in inspecting the river mouths.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，命為欽差大臣，赴天津治防。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed imperial commissioner and sent to Tianjin to organize coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed imperial commissioner and sent to Tianjin to organize the defenses.

sentences.zh: 和議成，撤防回京。

translations.literal: When peace was concluded he withdrew the garrisons and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After the peace settlement he stood down the defenses and returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 初，京師添設槍隊，命賽尚阿偕左都御史恩桂司訓練。

translations.literal: Earlier, when a musket corps was added in the capital, Sai Shang'a was ordered together with the left censor-in-chief En Gui to supervise its training.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when a musket corps was added in the capital, Sai Shang'a and Left Censor-in-Chief En Gui were put in charge of its training.

sentences.zh: 至是上閱武，槍隊獨整，嘉其督率有方，賜花翎。

translations.literal: When the emperor reviewed the troops on this occasion, the musket corps alone was perfectly drilled; he praised Sai Shang'a's effective supervision and bestowed the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: At the imperial review the musket corps alone stood out as perfectly drilled; the emperor praised his leadership and awarded him the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，命覆訊通州民婦康王氏勒斃親姑獄，白其冤，論坊官逼供罪如律。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was ordered to re-hear the case of the Tongzhou commoner woman Lady Kang, convicted of forcing her mother-in-law to death; he cleared her of wrongdoing and sentenced the ward officials for coerced confession according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1844) he was ordered to rehear the case of the Tongzhou woman Lady Kang, who had been convicted of forcing her mother-in-law to death; he cleared her of guilt and punished the ward officials for extorting confessions as the law required.

sentences.zh: 調戶部尚書，赴江南查閱江防善後事宜。

translations.literal: He was transferred to minister of the Ministry of Revenue and sent to the lower Yangtze to inspect river defense and post-crisis arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: He was made minister of revenue and sent south to inspect Yangtze defenses and post-crisis arrangements.

sentences.zh: 三十年，兼步軍統領、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he concurrently served as commander of the Metropolitan Gendarmerie and associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year (1850) he also took charge of the Metropolitan Gendarmerie and became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，拜文華殿大學士，管理戶部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and placed in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng (1851) he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 時廣西匪亂方熾，巡撫週天爵、提督向榮會剿，不能制賊，起用林則徐，未至，道卒。

translations.literal: At that time the bandit turmoil in Guangxi was raging; Governor Zhou Tianjue and Regional Commander Xiang Rong jointly suppressed them but could not control the rebels; Lin Zexu was recalled to service but died on the road before arriving.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rebellion in Guangxi was blazing; Governor Zhou Tianjue and Regional Commander Xiang Rong campaigned together but could not contain the rebels; Lin Zexu was brought back into service but died on the journey before he arrived.

sentences.zh: 李星沅督師，諸將不用命，亦無功。

translations.literal: Li Xingyuan supervised the army, but the generals would not obey orders and likewise achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xingyuan took command of the campaign, but the generals would not obey him and the effort likewise came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 文宗深憂之，以賽尚阿親信近臣，命為欽差大臣，赴湖南防堵，將以代星沅也，特賜遏必隆刀，給庫帑二百萬兩備軍餉。

translations.literal: The Wenzong Emperor was deeply troubled; because Sai Shang'a was a trusted intimate minister, he was appointed imperial commissioner to go to Hunan to block the rebels, intending to replace Xingyuan; he was specially granted the Yebilong saber and given two million taels from the treasury for military funds.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong was deeply alarmed; because Sai Shang'a was a trusted intimate, he was made imperial commissioner to go to Hunan and block the rebels, intending him to replace Xingyuan; he was specially given the ceremonial Yebilong saber and two million taels from the treasury for military expenses.

sentences.zh: 副都統巴清德、達洪阿率京軍隨行，姚瑩、嚴正基參軍事；

translations.literal: Vice commanders Ba Qingde and Da Hong'a led capital troops in his train; Yao Ying and Yan Zhengji assisted in military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Vice commanders Ba Qingde and Da Hong'a led capital troops with him, while Yao Ying and Yan Zhengji served on his military staff;

sentences.zh: 又調湖南在籍知縣江忠源赴營。

translations.literal: Jiang Zhongyuan, a Hunan county magistrate on leave in his home province, was also summoned to the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyuan, a Hunan county magistrate serving at home on leave, was also called to join the camp.

sentences.zh: 未幾，星沅卒於軍，趣賽尚阿馳往督師，授內大臣。

translations.literal: Before long Xingyuan died in the army; Sai Shang'a was urgently ordered to hurry there and take command, and was appointed an inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Xingyuan died in camp; Sai Shang'a was urgently ordered to hurry forward and take command, and was appointed an inner minister.

sentences.zh: 六月，至廣西，疏陳汰兵勇，明紀律，購間諜，散脅從，斷接濟五事，詔嘉其能通籌全局。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he reached Guangxi and memorialized on five measures: culling troops, clarifying discipline, hiring spies, dispersing coerced followers, and cutting off supplies; an edict praised his ability to plan the whole situation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he reached Guangxi and memorialized on five measures—culling ineffective troops, enforcing discipline, hiring spies, breaking up coerced followers, and severing rebel supply lines—and the court praised his grasp of the overall strategy.

sentences.zh: 週天爵與向榮不協，解其任，以鄒鳴鶴代之。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue and Xiang Rong were at odds; Zhou was removed from office and Zou Minghe was appointed in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zhou Tianjue and Xiang Rong could not work together, Zhou was dismissed and Zou Minghe was appointed governor in his stead.

sentences.zh: 又疏陳賊勢，略言：「粵西股匪繁多，馮雲山、洪秀全、凌十八等俱奉天主教，凶狠稱最，來往於金田、東鄉、廟旺、中坪，官兵壁上環觀，有無可如何之勢。

translations.literal: He also memorialized on rebel strength, stating in summary: "Guangxi has many bands of rebels; Feng Yunshan, Hong Xiuquan, Ling Shiba, and others all follow the Catholic religion and are fiercest in cruelty, moving between Jintian, Dongxiang, Miaowang, and Zhongping, while government troops stand on the walls and look on, powerless to act."
translations.idiomatic: He also reported on rebel strength, writing in summary that Guangxi was overrun with rebel bands, that Feng Yunshan, Hong Xiuquan, Ling Shiba, and others all professed Catholicism and were the fiercest of the lot, operating between Jintian, Dongxiang, Miaowang, and Zhongping while government troops looked on from the walls, unable to do anything about it.

sentences.zh: 宜先用全力攻剿大股，一經得手，則分兵剿辦，方免顧此失彼之虞。

translations.literal: "The main force should first be used with full strength to attack the large bands; once success is gained, troops can be divided for suppression, thereby avoiding the worry of attending to one place and losing another."
translations.idiomatic: He argued that the army should first concentrate all its strength on the main rebel concentrations; once those were broken, forces could be divided for mop-up operations and the government would not be caught attending to one front while losing another.

sentences.zh: 省垣兵少，暫居中調遣，分派巴清德、達洪阿進剿。

translations.literal: "The provincial capital has few troops; for the moment I shall remain at the center to direct operations and assign Ba Qingde and Da Hong'a to advance in suppression."
translations.idiomatic: Because the provincial capital had too few troops, he would remain there to direct operations for the time being and dispatch Ba Qingde and Da Hong'a on the offensive.

sentences.zh: 」於是向榮連破賊於中坪及桂平新墟。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xiang Rong repeatedly defeated the rebels at Zhongping and at the new market in Guiping.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Xiang Rong won successive victories over the rebels at Zhongping and at Guiping's new market town.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭泰設伏，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: Wulantai laid an ambush and destroyed a great many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wulantai set an ambush and killed a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊竄踞紫荊山，以新墟、雙髻隘為門戶。

translations.literal: The rebels fled and occupied Zijing Mountain, using the new market and Shuangji Pass as their gateways.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew to Zijing Mountain, with the new market and Shuangji Pass as their gateways.

sentences.zh: 達洪阿、烏蘭泰攻雙髻，毀其巢，賊自焚新墟而逸。

translations.literal: Da Hong'a and Wulantai attacked Shuangji, destroyed their lair, and the rebels burned the new market themselves and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Da Hong'a and Wulantai attacked Shuangji and destroyed the rebel base; the rebels burned the new market themselves and escaped.

sentences.zh: 官軍失利，遂陷永安州，賽尚阿坐失機，降四級留任。

translations.literal: The government army suffered defeat and Yong'an Prefecture fell; Sai Shang'a was held responsible for missing the opportunity and was demoted four ranks but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: The government forces were defeated and Yong'an fell; Sai Shang'a was blamed for missing his chance and was demoted four ranks while kept in post.

sentences.zh: 詔責諸軍並力進攻，水竇為永安​​要隘，烏蘭泰攻拔之，乃合圍。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked the armies and ordered them to advance together with full force; Shuidou was the key pass of Yong'an; Wulantai stormed and took it, and then the encirclement was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The court rebuked the armies and ordered a combined assault; Shuidou was Yong'an's critical pass, and once Wulantai stormed and took it the encirclement was complete.

sentences.zh: 向榮任北路，烏蘭泰任南路。

translations.literal: Xiang Rong was assigned the northern route and Wulantai the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong took the northern sector and Wulantai the southern.

sentences.zh: 永安城小而堅，環攻四閱月不能下，嚴詔趣戰。

translations.literal: Yong'an city was small but stout; besieged for four months it could not be taken, and stern edicts urged battle.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an was small but strongly fortified; after four months of siege it still had not fallen, and stern edicts pressed for action.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，賽尚阿親往督之，用向榮策，缺城北一隅不置兵，縱其出，因而擊之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Sai Shang'a went in person to supervise; adopting Xiang Rong's plan, he left one corner of the north wall without troops, allowed the rebels to break out, and then struck them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year (1852) Sai Shang'a went in person to direct operations; following Xiang Rong's plan, he left one stretch of the north wall unguarded, let the rebels break out, and then attacked them.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭泰爭之不得，素與榮不協，至是益相水火。

translations.literal: Wulantai disputed the plan but could not prevail; he had long been at odds with Xiang Rong, and now they became still more irreconcilable.
translations.idiomatic: Wulantai objected but could not prevail; he had long been at odds with Xiang Rong, and now their hostility became outright.

sentences.zh: 二月，賊果由此路突出，官軍不能禦，僅獲洪大全，檻送京師，以收復永安上聞；

translations.literal: In the second month the rebels indeed broke out by this route; the government army could not stop them, capturing only Hong Daquan and sending him in a cage to the capital, reporting the recovery of Yong'an;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the rebels broke out exactly by that route; government troops could not stop them, capturing only Hong Daquan and sending him to the capital in a cage while reporting Yong'an as recovered;

sentences.zh: 而賊遽犯桂林，向榮走間道入城守禦，烏蘭泰尾追至將軍橋，猝被砲傷，旋殞於軍，總兵長瑞、長壽、董光甲、邵鶴齡亦戰歿。

translations.literal: but the rebels swiftly attacked Guilin; Xiang Rong took a bypath into the city to defend it; Wulantai pursued to Jiangjun Bridge, was suddenly wounded by cannon fire, and soon died in the army; brigade generals Chang Rui, Chang Shou, Dong Guangjia, and Shao Heling also fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: but the rebels at once threatened Guilin; Xiang Rong slipped into the city by a side road to organize the defense; Wulantai pursued to Jiangjun Bridge, was struck down by artillery, and died in camp; brigade generals Chang Rui, Chang Shou, Dong Guangjia, and Shao Heling also fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿自請治罪，詔責戴罪以圖補救，命兩廣總督徐廣縉率師赴援。

translations.literal: Sai Shang'a asked to be punished; an edict rebuked him but allowed him to retain his post to seek remedy, and ordered the Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi Xu Guangjin to lead troops to the relief.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Shang'a asked to be punished; the court rebuked him but let him keep his post to make amends and ordered Governor-General Xu Guangjin of the two Guang provinces to bring troops to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 賊見桂林守具已完，援師漸集，解圍北竄，連陷興安、全州。

translations.literal: Seeing Guilin's defenses complete and relief forces gradually gathering, the rebels raised the siege and fled north, successively taking Xing'an and Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Guilin's defenses in order and relief forces gathering, the rebels broke off the siege and fled north, taking Xing'an and Quanzhou in succession.

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿始入駐省城，遣提督餘萬清、總兵劉長清進攻全州。

translations.literal: Sai Shang'a only then entered and garrisoned the provincial capital, dispatching Regional Commander Yu Wanqing and Brigade General Liu Changqing to attack Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did Sai Shang'a move into the provincial capital and send Regional Commander Yu Wanqing and Brigade General Liu Changqing to attack Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 江忠源破賊於蓑衣渡，斃悍賊馮雲山。

translations.literal: Jiang Zhongyuan defeated the rebels at Suoyi Ford and killed the fierce rebel Feng Yunshan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyuan routed the rebels at Suoyi Ford and killed the formidable rebel leader Feng Yunshan.

sentences.zh: 賊遂入湖南，連陷道州、江華、永明、嘉禾、藍山、桂陽，賽尚阿尾之，抵衡陽。

translations.literal: The rebels then entered Hunan, successively taking Daozhou, Jianghua, Yongming, Jiahe, Lanshan, and Guiyang; Sai Shang'a followed in their wake and reached Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then pushed into Hunan, taking Daozhou, Jianghua, Yongming, Jiahe, Lanshan, and Guiyang in succession; Sai Shang'a followed in their wake as far as Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 賊由郴州分竄醴陵、攸縣，尋犯長沙，勢益鴟張。

translations.literal: From Chenzhou the rebels split off into Liling and Youxian, and soon attacked Changsha; their momentum grew ever more arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: From Chenzhou they fanned out into Liling and Youxian, then threatened Changsha, and their power swelled ever more menacingly.

sentences.zh: 湖南巡撫羅繞典以聞，文宗震怒，詔斥賽尚阿調度無方，號令不明，賞罰失當，以致勞師糜餉，日久無功，褫職逮京治罪。

translations.literal: Hunan Governor Luo Raodian reported this; the Wenzong Emperor was enraged and issued an edict rebuking Sai Shang'a for disorderly command, unclear orders, and improper rewards and punishments, thereby exhausting the army and wasting funds with long delay and no success; he was stripped of office and brought to the capital for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When Hunan Governor Luo Raodian reported the situation, Emperor Wenzong was furious; an edict denounced Sai Shang'a for confused command, muddled orders, and skewed rewards and punishments that had worn out the army, wasted funds, and produced nothing over months; he was stripped of office and sent to the capital for trial.

sentences.zh: 命大學士等會鞫，賽尚阿伏地流涕，自言不忍殺人辜負聖恩，論大辟，籍其家，三子並褫職。

translations.literal: Grand secretaries and others were ordered to conduct a joint trial; Sai Shang'a prostrated himself in tears, saying he could not bear to kill people and had failed the imperial grace; he was sentenced to death, his property was confiscated, and his three sons were all stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries and others were ordered to try him jointly; Sai Shang'a prostrated himself in tears and said he could not bring himself to kill and had betrayed the emperor's trust; he was sentenced to death, his property was confiscated, and all three of his sons were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，釋出獄，發往直隸，交訥爾經額差遣，調京隨辦巡防。

translations.literal: Before long he was released from prison, sent to Zhili, placed under the orders of Ne'erjing'e, and transferred to the capital to assist in patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was released from prison, sent to Zhili under Ne'erjing'e's command, and recalled to the capital to help with patrol defense.

sentences.zh: 五年，遣戍軍台，尋釋之，命練察哈爾蒙古兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was banished to the military colonies; soon he was released and ordered to drill the Chahar Mongol troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1855) he was banished to the military colonies; he was soon released and ordered to train the Chahar Mongol troops.

sentences.zh: 十年，回京，總統左翼巡城事宜，予侍郎銜，授正紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he returned to the capital, took overall charge of left-wing city patrol affairs, was granted vice-ministerial rank, and appointed vice commander of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1860) he returned to Beijing, took charge of left-wing city patrols, was given vice-ministerial rank, and was appointed vice commander of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 以病免。

translations.literal: He was excused from office on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Guangxu (1875).

sentences.zh: 子崇綺，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Chongqi has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chongqi has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額，字近堂，費莫氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e, courtesy name Jintang, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e, whose courtesy name was Jintang, belonged to the Feimo clan and came from the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年繙譯進士，授妃園寢禮部主事，調工部，洊升郎中。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiaqing he passed the translation-track metropolitan examination, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Rites for the imperial consorts' tombs, was transferred to the Ministry of Works, and was repeatedly promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 8 (1803) he qualified as a translation-track metropolitan graduate, served in the Ministry of Rites for the imperial consorts' tombs, moved to the Ministry of Works, and rose in steady succession to director.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，出為山東兗沂曹道，遷湖南按察使，丁憂去職。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he went out as intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao circuit in Shandong, was transferred to Hunan provincial surveillance commissioner, and left office on mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang (1821) he became intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao circuit in Shandong, was transferred to Hunan surveillance commissioner, and left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 三年，起署山東按察使，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the third year he was recalled to serve as acting Shandong surveillance commissioner and soon received substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1823) he was recalled to serve as acting Shandong surveillance commissioner and soon received a substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 承鞫教匪馬進忠獄得實，賜花翎，就遷布政使。

translations.literal: He took charge of trying the sect rebel Ma Jinzhong and established the facts; he was granted the peacock feather and was promoted on the spot to provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He took charge of the trial of the sect rebel Ma Jinzhong, proved the case, was awarded the peacock feather, and was promoted on the spot to provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢漕運總督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1826) he was promoted to Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 九年，調山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1829) he was made governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1832) he was promoted to Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十六年，湖南新寧瑤生藍正樽習教傳徒，聚眾數千，攻武岡州城，為官兵擊退。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Lan Zhengzun, a Yao tribesman of Xinning in Hunan who practiced the sect and taught disciples, gathered several thousand men and attacked Wugang prefectural city but was repelled by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1836) Lan Zhengzun, a Yao from Xinning in Hunan who practiced the sect and gathered followers, mustered several thousand men and attacked Wugang but was driven back by government troops.

sentences.zh: 捕獲黨羽，而正樽逃逸，詔責訥爾經額嚴緝，久不獲，革職留任。

translations.literal: His followers were captured but Zhengzun escaped; an edict rebuked Ne'erjing'e for strict pursuit; after long failure to capture him, he was dismissed from office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: His followers were captured but Zhengzun escaped; the court rebuked Ne'erjing'e for failing to hunt him down vigorously; after a long failure to capture him, he was stripped of rank but kept in post.

sentences.zh: 十七年，京察考績，詔斥訥爾經額玩洩無能，降湖南巡撫，限一年捕正樽。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, in the capital performance review, an edict rebuked Ne'erjing'e for lax indulgence and incompetence, demoted him to Hunan governor, and set a one-year limit to capture Zhengzun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1837), at the capital performance review, an edict denounced Ne'erjing'e for slack incompetence, demoted him to governor of Hunan, and gave him one year to capture Zhengzun.

sentences.zh: 尋以正樽已被鄉勇毆斃，奏下繼任總督林則徐確查虛實，則徐疏言鄉勇毆斃三賊，有正樽在內，以衣物為證，詔斥衣物出於事後呈驗，不足信，褫訥爾經額職，予三等侍衛，充駐藏辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Soon it was reported that Zhengzun had been beaten to death by local militia; the memorial was sent down to his successor Governor-General Lin Zexu to verify the facts; Lin memorialized that the militia had beaten three rebels to death, Zhengzun among them, with clothing as proof; an edict rebuked this, saying the clothing was presented for inspection only afterward and was not credible; Ne'erjing'e was stripped of office, granted third-class bodyguard rank, and appointed Commissioner in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Soon word came that local militia had beaten Zhengzun to death; the report was sent to his successor Lin Zexu for verification; Lin wrote that militia had killed three rebels, Zhengzun among them, citing clothing as evidence; the court rejected this, saying the clothing had been produced only afterward and was not credible; Ne'erjing'e was dismissed, given third-class bodyguard rank, and appointed commissioner in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 逾年，晉頭等侍衛，調西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: After a year he was promoted to first-class bodyguard and transferred to Commissioner at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was promoted to first-class bodyguard and transferred to commissioner at Xining.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢熱河都統。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to commander at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1840) he was promoted to commander at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 俄授陝甘總督，未之任，命署直隸總督，尋實授。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu but did not take up the post; he was ordered to act as Governor-General of Zhili and soon received substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu but never took up the post; instead he was made acting Governor-General of Zhili and soon received a substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，英吉利兵船游弋秦王島，命訥爾經額移駐天津籌防，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year English warships cruised off Qinhuang Island; Ne'erjing'e was ordered to move his headquarters to Tianjin to organize defense and was given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1841) British warships appeared off Qinhuang Island; Ne'erjing'e was ordered to move to Tianjin to organize the defenses and was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 時漸多事，財政支絀，疆臣猶因襲承平舊制，憚於興革。

translations.literal: The times were gradually growing troubled, finances strained, yet frontier governors still followed the old institutions of peace and shrank from reform.
translations.idiomatic: Troubles were mounting and finances were strained, yet frontier governors still clung to peacetime routines and shrank from reform.

sentences.zh: 廷議興屯墾及畿輔水利，訥爾經額疏言：「屯田不能行於畿輔，先朝試行水利，屢興屢廢。

translations.literal: The court debated promoting military colonies and waterworks in the metropolitan region; Ne'erjing'e memorialized: "Military colonies cannot be implemented in the metropolitan region; previous dynasties tried waterworks repeatedly, starting and abandoning them again and again."
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated military colonies and waterworks around the capital, Ne'erjing'e argued that colonies could not work in the metropolitan region and that earlier attempts at waterworks had been started and abandoned again and again.

sentences.zh: 良由南北異宜，民多未便。

translations.literal: "This was truly because north and south differ in suitability and the people found it largely inconvenient."
translations.idiomatic: This, he said, was because north and south had different conditions and the people found such schemes largely impractical.

sentences.zh: 」寢其議。

translations.literal: The proposal was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 又言官請長蘆懸岸鹽額如河南、山東，改歸官辦。

translations.literal: Officials also proposed that the salt quota for the suspended banks of Changlu, like Henan and Shandong, be changed to government operation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials also proposed bringing the Changlu suspended-bank salt quota under direct government operation, as in Henan and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額言：「懸岸由於私充引滯，但使梟販斂跡，民販亦可持久，諸商不招自至。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e said: "The suspended banks arise from private filling that blocks the salt certificates; if only smugglers are curbed, private merchants can also endure, and the licensed merchants will come without being summoned."
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e replied that suspended banks resulted from illegal filling that blocked salt transport; if smuggling were suppressed, licensed private trade could continue and merchants would return without being summoned.

sentences.zh: 不必務官辦之虛名，徒事更張，無裨實用。

translations.literal: "There is no need to pursue the empty name of government operation and merely change the system to no practical benefit."
translations.idiomatic: There was no need, he argued, to chase the empty label of government monopoly and reshuffle the system to no practical gain.

sentences.zh: 」咸豐二年，以直隸總督協辦大學士，尋拜文淵閣大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he became associate grand secretary while serving as Governor-General of Zhili, and soon was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth while retaining the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2 (1852) he became associate grand secretary while remaining Governor-General of Zhili, and soon was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth while keeping the governorship.

sentences.zh: 三年，粵匪既踞江寧，分黨由安徽入河南，歸德、睢州、寧陵、蘭封相繼陷，河南巡撫陸應穀敗績。

translations.literal: In the third year, after the Guangdong rebels had occupied Jiangning, a detachment entered Henan from Anhui; Guide, Suizhou, Ningling, and Lanfeng fell in succession, and Henan Governor Lu Yinggu suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1853), with the Taiping holding Nanjing, a rebel column entered Henan from Anhui; Guide, Suizhou, Ningling, and Lanfeng fell in succession, and Henan Governor Lu Yinggu was defeated.

sentences.zh: 賊窺開封，命訥爾經額防守大名，遏賊北竄。

translations.literal: The rebels threatened Kaifeng; Ne'erjing'e was ordered to defend Daming and block the rebels' northward flight.
translations.idiomatic: As the rebels threatened Kaifeng, Ne'erjing'e was ordered to hold Daming and block any northward breakout.

sentences.zh: 令總兵花里雅遜布屯延津防河，雙祿守彰德為後繼，而賊酋林鳳祥、李開芳已自汜水渡河，陷溫縣，犯懷慶。

translations.literal: Brigade General Hualiyaxunbu was ordered to garrison Yanjin to guard the river, Shuang Lu to hold Zhangde as reserve, but the rebel chiefs Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang had already crossed the river at Sishui, taken Wen County, and attacked Huaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade General Hualiyaxunbu was posted at Yanjin to guard the river and Shuang Lu at Zhangde as reserve, but rebel chiefs Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang had already crossed at Sishui, taken Wen County, and were threatening Huaiqing.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額檄總兵董占元赴援，自駐臨洺關，請增調盛京、吉林步騎。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e ordered Brigade General Dong Zhanyuan to the relief, himself garrisoned at Linzhang Pass, and requested additional infantry and cavalry from Mukden and Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e ordered Brigade General Dong Zhanyuan to the relief, took post himself at Linzhang Pass, and requested reinforcements of infantry and cavalry from Mukden and Jilin.

sentences.zh: 詔授訥爾經額為欽差大臣，節制河南、北諸軍。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Ne'erjing'e imperial commissioner with command over the armies of Henan and the north.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed imperial commissioner with authority over the armies of Henan and the northern front.

sentences.zh: 賊圍懷慶久，知府余炳燾率紳民固守，賊周樹木柵為久困計。

translations.literal: The rebels besieged Huaiqing for a long time; Prefect Yu Bingtao led gentry and people in a stout defense; the rebels built wooden palisades all around for a prolonged siege.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels besieged Huaiqing for months; Prefect Yu Bingtao led local gentry and townspeople in a stubborn defense while the rebels ringed the city with wooden palisades for a long siege.

sentences.zh: 援軍四集，惟都統勝保、將軍托明阿軍戰最力，花里雅遜布、董占元等隔丹水駐軍，畏賊不敢進。

translations.literal: Relief forces gathered from four directions; only the armies of Banner Commander Sheng Bao and General Tuoming'a fought most vigorously; Hualiyaxunbu, Dong Zhanyuan, and others camped across the Dan River and, fearing the rebels, dared not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Relief forces gathered from all sides; only Banner Commander Sheng Bao and General Tuoming'a fought with real vigor, while Hualiyaxunbu, Dong Zhanyuan, and others camped across the Dan River and, fearing the rebels, would not advance.

sentences.zh: 勝保屢以為言，詔促訥爾經額進師夾擊，並防賊竄入山西，乃進駐清化鎮。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao repeatedly reported this; an edict urged Ne'erjing'e to advance and attack from both sides and also guard against the rebels slipping into Shanxi; he then advanced and garrisoned Qinghua Town.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao complained repeatedly; the court ordered Ne'erjing'e to advance for a pincer attack and guard against a rebel breakout into Shanxi, and he then moved forward to Qinghua Town.

sentences.zh: 八月，諸軍五路合擊，破賊柵，賊大潰，圍乃解。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the armies attacked in five columns, broke the rebel palisades, the rebels were routed in great disorder, and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the armies struck in five columns, broke the rebel palisades, routed the rebels completely, and lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 文宗大悅，賜訥爾經額雙眼花翎、黃馬褂，賚擢諸將有差。

translations.literal: The Wenzong Emperor was greatly pleased, bestowed on Ne'erjing'e double-eyed peacock feathers and a yellow riding jacket, and rewarded and promoted the generals in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong was delighted, gave Ne'erjing'e double-eyed peacock feathers and a yellow riding jacket, and rewarded and promoted the generals to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 賊之敗竄也，諸軍以久戰疲罷，未能力追；

translations.literal: When the rebels were defeated and fled, the armies, worn out by long fighting, were unable to pursue vigorously;
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels broke and fled, the armies, exhausted by months of fighting, could not pursue with force;

sentences.zh: 山西兵多調援，設防不密。

translations.literal: Shanxi troops had largely been transferred to the relief effort, and defenses were not tight.
translations.idiomatic: most Shanxi troops had been sent to the relief effort, leaving the defenses thin.

sentences.zh: 賊遂由濟源入太行山，連陷垣曲、陽城、曲沃，犯平陽府，擾及洪洞，並失守。

translations.literal: The rebels then entered the Taihang Mountains from Jiyuan, successively taking Yuanqu, Yangcheng, and Quwo, attacking Pingyang Prefecture, and raiding as far as Hongtong, all of which fell.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then entered the Taihang Mountains from Jiyuan, took Yuanqu, Yangcheng, and Quwo in succession, threatened Pingyang, and raided as far as Hongtong, all of which fell.

sentences.zh: 追軍皆落後，惟勝保先進，戰於平陽，挫之。

translations.literal: The pursuing armies all lagged behind; only Sheng Bao advanced first, fought at Pingyang, and checked them.
translations.idiomatic: The pursuing armies all lagged behind; only Sheng Bao pushed ahead, fought at Pingyang, and checked them.

sentences.zh: 繞前扼賊北路，賊乃東趨。

translations.literal: He went around ahead and blocked the rebels' northern route; the rebels then turned east.
translations.idiomatic: He swung ahead to block their northern route, and the rebels then turned east.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額回駐臨洺關，素不知兵，束手無措。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e returned to garrison Linzhang Pass; he had never understood military affairs and was at a complete loss.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e fell back to Linzhang Pass; he had never understood warfare and was utterly at a loss.

sentences.zh: 或告潞城、黎城間有孔道，循太行東出武安，密邇臨洺，然險隘可扼。

translations.literal: Someone reported that between Lucheng and Licheng there was a passable route along the eastern Taihang to Wu'an, close to Linzhang, yet defensible at the narrow passes.
translations.idiomatic: Someone warned that between Lucheng and Licheng a route ran east along the Taihang to Wu'an, very close to Linzhang, though it could be blocked at the narrow passes.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額以非直隸轄境，諮山西巡撫守禦。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e, because it was not within Zhili jurisdiction, consulted the Shanxi governor to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: Because the route lay outside Zhili, Ne'erjing'e referred the matter to the Shanxi governor for defense.

sentences.zh: 既而賊果破黎、潞，猶謂賊不能遽至。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels indeed broke through Li and Lu, yet he still said the rebels could not arrive quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the rebels did break through Li and Lu, yet he still insisted they could not arrive quickly.

sentences.zh: 忽有冒欽差大臣旗幟責州縣供張者，蓋賊之前驅已出山矣。

translations.literal: Suddenly men bearing the banners of an imperial commissioner demanded provisions from the prefecture and counties—it turned out the rebels' vanguard had already come out of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly men flying imperial commissioner banners were demanding provisions from local officials—the rebel vanguard had already come out of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 俄而麕至，官軍出不意，驚潰，訥爾經額以數十人走保廣平府城，關防、令箭、軍書、資械委棄皆盡。

translations.literal: Before long they swarmed in; the government army, taken unawares, broke in panic; Ne'erjing'e fled with several dozen men to take refuge in Guangping prefectural city, abandoning official seals, command arrows, military documents, supplies, and weapons entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the rebels swarmed in; caught off guard, government troops broke and fled in panic; Ne'erjing'e escaped with only a few dozen men into Guangping city, leaving behind his seals, command arrows, dispatches, supplies, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 事聞，褫職，留於直隸隨同辦理軍務。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported he was stripped of office but retained in Zhili to assist in handling military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court he was stripped of office but kept in Zhili to help manage military affairs.

sentences.zh: 賊遂大熾，畿輔半被蹂躪，京師震動。

translations.literal: The rebels then grew greatly in strength; half the metropolitan region was ravaged and the capital was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then surged in strength; half the capital region was laid waste and Beijing was shaken.

sentences.zh: 命惠親王綿愉為大將軍，科爾沁郡王僧格林沁副之，勝保督師前敵追剿。

translations.literal: Prince Mianyu of the First Rank was appointed general-in-chief, the Khorchin prince Sengge Rinchen as his deputy, and Sheng Bao to command pursuit at the front.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Mianyu of the First Rank was made general-in-chief, with Khorchin Prince Sengge Rinchen as his deputy and Sheng Bao commanding the pursuit at the front.

sentences.zh: 於是逮訥爾經額下獄，論斬監候。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ne'erjing'e was arrested and imprisoned, sentenced to death with imprisonment pending execution.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e was then arrested and sentenced to death, execution suspended.

sentences.zh: 逾年始殄賊，先後擒首逆林鳳祥、李開芳伏誅，畿輔肅清。

translations.literal: After more than a year the rebels were finally exterminated; the chief rebels Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang were captured in succession and executed, and the metropolitan region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year passed before the rebels were finally destroyed; chief leaders Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang were captured and executed in turn, and the capital region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 赦訥爾經額出獄，遣戍軍台。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e was pardoned and released from prison, then banished to the military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: He was pardoned, released from prison, and sent into exile at the military colonies.

sentences.zh: 逾年釋回，予六品頂戴，命守慕陵。

translations.literal: After a year he was released and recalled, granted a sixth-rank official cap button, and ordered to guard the imperial mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was released and recalled, given a sixth-rank cap button, and assigned to guard the imperial mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 尋以四五品京堂候補。

translations.literal: Soon he was placed on the waiting list for fourth- and fifth-rank capital posts.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon placed on the waiting list for fourth- and fifth-rank posts in the capital.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 子蘊秀、衍秀，並官內閣學士。

translations.literal: His sons Yunxiu and Yanxiu both served as Grand Secretariat academicians.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Yunxiu and Yanxiu both rose to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 論曰：清沿故事，有大軍事，輒以滿洲重臣督師。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The Qing followed established precedent whereby, when there was a major military affair, a heavyweight Manchu minister was placed in command of the army.
translations.idiomatic: The historian remarks: Following established Qing practice, major military campaigns were entrusted to senior Manchu ministers as commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乾、嘉時，如阿桂、福康安、勒保、額勒登保等，皆胸有韜略，功在旂常。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong and Jiaqing periods, men such as Agui, Fukang'an, Lebao, and Eledengbao all possessed strategy in their breasts and had achievements recorded in the honors registers.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong and Jiaqing, men such as Agui, Fukang'an, Lebao, and Eledengbao were all skilled strategists whose achievements were entered in the court's rolls of honor.

sentences.zh: 道光以來，惟長齡平定回疆，差堪繼武。

translations.literal: Since Daoguang, only Changling in pacifying the Western Regions could barely continue this martial tradition.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Daoguang reign only Changling, in pacifying the Western Regions, could be said to carry on that martial tradition.

sentences.zh: 其後禧恩之徵瑤，奕山、奕經之防海，或以驕侈召謗，或以輕率僨事。

translations.literal: Afterward, in Xi'en's campaign against the Yao, and in Yishan and Yijing's coastal defense, some invited censure through arrogance and extravagance, others ruined affairs through rashness.
translations.idiomatic: After that, Xi'en's campaign against the Yao and the coastal defense efforts of Yishan and Yijing brought censure through arrogance and extravagance in some cases and failure through rashness in others.

sentences.zh: 至粵匪初起，李星沅不勝任，易以賽尚阿，馭將無方，遂致寇不可製。

translations.literal: When the Guangdong rebels first arose, Li Xingyuan proved unequal to the task; Sai Shang'a was substituted for him, but he could not command his generals and thus the bandits became uncontrollable.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebellion first broke out, Li Xingyuan proved inadequate; Sai Shang'a replaced him but could not control his generals, and the rebels became unmanageable.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額庸懦同之，畿甸震驚，自是朝廷始知其弊。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e was likewise mediocre and timid; the metropolitan district was shaken with alarm, and from this the court first came to know the defect.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e was no better—mediocre and timid—and when the capital region was thrown into alarm the court at last recognized the flaw in this system.

sentences.zh: 惟僧格林沁猶以勳望膺其任，不復輕以中樞閣部出任師幹，即有時親籓遙領，亦居其名不行其實。

translations.literal: Only Sengge Rinchen still undertook the post by virtue of his merit and prestige; the court no longer lightly sent Grand Council and ministry officials to command armies, and even when imperial princes nominally supervised from afar, they held the title but did not carry out the reality.
translations.idiomatic: Only Sengge Rinchen still took such commands, by virtue of his battlefield prestige; the court no longer lightly sent Grand Council and ministry officials to lead armies, and even when imperial princes nominally supervised campaigns from afar, they held the title without exercising real command.

sentences.zh: 蓋人材時會使然，固不可與國初入關時並論也。

translations.literal: This was fundamentally because talent and the times made it so, and indeed cannot be discussed on the same terms as when the dynasty first entered the Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Talent and circumstance had changed, and the age could no longer be compared with the dynasty's first generations after entering China.
